sets.title: A voicemail from Sara
sets.transcript: Hi Paolo, it's Sara. I'm calling about Saturday. The weather forecast says it's going to rain, so we aren't going to the beach. Instead, let's go to the cinema. There's a new comedy at the Odeon. It starts at half past seven. Can we meet at the café next to the cinema at seven? I'm bringing my cousin Anna. She arrived from London yesterday. Call me back or send me a message. Bye!
